## 
I am a Professor of Geography and Founding Director of the [Center for Open Geographical Science](http://cogs.sdsu.edu) at San Diego State University.
My research interests are in **spatial data science**, with a focus on **spatial inequality, regional science, and open-source geospatial computing**. I am the lead developer of **[PySAL](http://pysal.org)**.
